'''Kaz''' (Japanese: '''カズ''' ''Kaz'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP042|Showdown at Dark City]]''. He is the Leader of the [[Kaz Gym]] in [[Dark City]].

Kaz's goal is to get his Gym recognized as the only official [[Gym]] in Dark City in order to make money. He, therefore, has a bitter rivalry with the other would-be Leader [[Yas]] and his [[Yas Gym]]. To this end, the two Leaders and their pupils have been battling constantly, much to the detriment of the residents of Dark City. During a confrontation between the two Gyms, Kaz sends his {{p|Electabuzz}} against Yas' {{p|Scyther}} but {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and a group of local children spilled ketchup on him, Yas, and {{TRT}}. As both Scyther and Electabuzz have a strong aversion to the color red, these two battling Pokémon turned on their Trainers.

After their Pokémon run into each other, the two Leaders go after Ash, {{an|Misty}}, {{an|Brock}}, and the three kids who helped them. {{AP|Pikachu}} then fends them off with a {{m|Thunder}}. His dreams of wealth through leading an official Gym are dashed when a disguised [[Nurse Joy]], acting as a member of the [[Pokémon Inspection Agency]], reveals herself and declares both him and his rival unfit to be Gym Leaders.
